items.stem: Why is random k-fold cross-validation usually inappropriate for time-series forecasting?

options.text: It lets the model train on future data and test on the past, leaking information
options.rationale: Correct: shuffling breaks temporal order and leaks future into training.

options.text: It cannot compute any error metric
options.rationale: It can compute metrics; the problem is leakage.
Fit quality is unrelated to the ordering issue.
